p: written with a pen of iron: The remembrance of their contempt of God cannot pass, although for a time he defers the punishment, for it will be revealed to men and angels.
tablet of their heart: Instead of the law of God, they have written idolatry and all abomination in their heart.
altars: Your sins appear in all the altars that you have erected to idols.
While their children remember their altars: Some read, "So that their children remember their altars", that is, follow their father's wickedness.
O my mountain in the field: Zion that was my mountain, will now be left as a waste field.
thyself: Because you would not give the land rest, at such times, days and years as I appointed, you will after this be carried away and it will rest for lack of labourers.

Cursed be the man that trusteth: The Jews were given to worldly policies and thought to make themselves strong by the friendship of the Egyptians, Isa 31:3 and strangers and in the mean time did not depend on God, and therefore he denounces God's plagues against them, showing that they prefer corruptible man to God, who is immortal, Isa 2:22, Jer 48:6,7.
For he shall be as a: Read Ps 1:3.

The heart is deceitful above all: Because the wicked always have some excuse to defend their doings he shows that their own lewd imaginations deceive them and bring them to these hardships: but God will examine their deeds by the malice of their hearts, 1Sa 16:7,1Ch 28:9,Ps 7:10,Jer 11:20,10:12,Re 2:13.

As the partridge sitteth on eggs: As the patriarch by calling gathered others who forsake her when they see she is not their mother: so the covetous man is forsaken of his riches because he comes by them falsely.
high throne from the beginning is: Showing that the godly ought to glory in nothing, but in God who exalts his, and has left a sign of his favour in his temple.
in the earth: Their names will not be registered in the book of life.
save me: He desires God to preserve him that he fall not into temptation, considering the great contempt of God's word, and the multitude that fall from God.
they say to me: The wicked say that my prophecy will not come to pass, because you deferred the time of your vengeance.
I have not hastened from being: I am assured of my calling, and therefore know that the thing which you speak by me will come to pass, and that I speak not of any worldly affection.
a terror to me: However the wicked deal rigorously with me, yet let me find comfort in you.
and destroy them with double destruction: Read Jer 11:20.
gate of the children of the: While your doctrine may best be understood both by high and low.

sabbath day: By naming the Sabbath day, he comprehends the thing that is signified by it, for if they transgressed in the ceremony, they must be guilty of the rest, read Ex 20:8 and by the breaking of this one commandment, he makes them transgressors of the whole law, as the first and second table are contained in it.
